findings.notes_status: Working notes only; Lead content checks and final report facts use verified scoped evidence.
findings.findings:
- Tim Duncan's regular-season scoring volume across 2000-01 through 2002-03 totaled 5,803 points with an average of 23.97 PPG (ev_6181b32f30baba95c4fc).
- Dirk Nowitzki's regular-season scoring volume across 2004-05 through 2006-07 totaled 6,243 points with an average of 25.48 PPG (ev_0317540d60bb77290e20).
- Dirk Nowitzki leads both total points (+440) and points per game (+1.51 PPG) over their respective three-season windows, contradicting the claim (ev_6181b32f30baba95c4fc, ev_0317540d60bb77290e20).
- League scoring environments differed between the two windows: Tim Duncan's span averaged a league True Shooting percentage of ~51.92%, whereas Dirk Nowitzki's span averaged a league True Shooting percentage of ~53.55% (ev_6181b32f30baba95c4fc, ev_0317540d60bb77290e20).
- Tim Duncan achieved a shot-opportunity-weighted relative TS of +3.99 percentage points above league average (ev_6181b32f30baba95c4fc).
- Dirk Nowitzki achieved a shot-opportunity-weighted relative TS of +5.49 percentage points above league average (ev_0317540d60bb77290e20).
- Both players maintained 100% shooting-opportunity coverage across their respective three-season windows with zero missing seasons (ev_6181b32f30baba95c4fc, ev_0317540d60bb77290e20).

findings.findings:
- Tim Duncan played 245 regular-season games across the 2000-01 through 2002-03 window, totaling 5,793 points and averaging 23.64 points per game (ev_926bbe8adf175150e740, ev_223b3345045acaf2dbcd).
- Tim Duncan recorded 4,302 field-goal attempts (FGA) across his three-season window (ev_926bbe8adf175150e740).
- Dirk Nowitzki played 237 regular-season games across the 2004-05 through 2006-07 window, totaling 6,099 points and averaging 25.73 points per game (ev_a171181b8ac6def322a6, ev_d8a2224965653b811e91).
- Dirk Nowitzki recorded 4,350 field-goal attempts (FGA) across his three-season window (ev_a171181b8ac6def322a6).
- Dirk Nowitzki led in total points (6,099 to 5,793) and points per game (25.73 to 23.64) over their respective three-season windows (ev_926bbe8adf175150e740, ev_223b3345045acaf2dbcd, ev_a171181b8ac6def322a6, ev_d8a2224965653b811e91).
- Dirk Nowitzki also led in total field-goal attempts (4,350 to 4,302) and field-goal attempts per game (18.35 to 17.56) over the comparative windows (ev_926bbe8adf175150e740, ev_223b3345045acaf2dbcd, ev_a171181b8ac6def322a6, ev_d8a2224965653b811e91).
- The claim that Tim Duncan scored more strongly than Dirk Nowitzki over their respective windows is unsupported by the regular-season volume totals and per-game averages (ev_926bbe8adf175150e740, ev_223b3345045acaf2dbcd, ev_a171181b8ac6def322a6, ev_d8a2224965653b811e91).
- All statistics reflect official regular-season participation and do not extrapolate missed games or hypothetical full-season schedules (ev_926bbe8adf175150e740, ev_223b3345045acaf2dbcd, ev_a171181b8ac6def322a6, ev_d8a2224965653b811e91).
